scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
Oh!! You are a stranger!
I'm Ichack, the first adventurer that arrived here in El Dicastes!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
哦！来了一位外地人！
我叫伊查克，是第一个抵达埃尔迪卡特斯的冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
There was someone in the expedition team claiming that he was the first, but it WAS me. That's right.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
探险队里有人说自己才是第一个来的，可明明就是我！
没错，就是我。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
That's why I will provide a service to guide adventurers from Midgard.
What would you like to know?
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
所以，我来给米德加尔特的冒险者们当向导。
你想了解什么？

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
When you click on the ^B9062F[location name]^000000, you'll receive the most advanced ^B9062FNavigation^000000 services!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
点击^B9062F[地点名称]^000000，便可获得最先进的^B9062F导航^000000服务！

scripts.text: Dicastes Diel
scripts.translation: 迪卡斯提斯大厅

scripts.text: Residential Area
scripts.translation: 居住区

scripts.text: Training Room
scripts.translation: 训练室

scripts.text: Factory
scripts.translation: 工厂

scripts.text: Pub
scripts.translation: 酒馆

scripts.text: Cat Paw Caravan
scripts.translation: 猫爪商队

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
Ah~ That's a beautiful building.
It's said they discuss important things...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
啊~那座建筑可漂亮了。
听说他们会在里面商议大事...

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
Please make sure you signed in at the <NAVI>[Diel]<INFO>dicastes01,198,351,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, otherwise you'll get in trouble.
Go directly north from here and you can't miss it.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
请务必在<NAVI>[迪卡斯提斯大厅]<INFO>dicastes01,198,351,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>登记，否则会惹上麻烦。从这里一直向北走就能到。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
Please make sure you signed in at the Diel, otherwise you'll get in trouble.
Go directly north from here and you can't miss it.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
The Sapha tribe is so weird. How can they sleep in there?
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
萨法族真奇怪。那种地方怎么睡得着？

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
You don't understand?
You won't believe me until you see it! Go see it for yourself!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
听不明白？
不亲眼看看，你肯定不信！
自己去瞧瞧吧！

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
The residential area is divided into 2 areas.
The <NAVI>[lower residential area]<INFO>dicastes01,136,106,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> is around 7 o'clock, and the 
<NAVI>[upper area]<INFO>dicastes01,280,283,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> is around 1 o'clock.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
居住区分为两个区域。<NAVI>[下层居住区]<INFO>dicastes01,136,106,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>大约位于7点钟方向，而<NAVI>[上层区域]<INFO>dicastes01,280,283,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>大约位于1点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
Because of the dangers here, we need better security...
Have you ever been to the 
<NAVI>[training room]<INFO>dicastes01,255,172,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>? The training guards seem to never sleep!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
这里危机四伏，因此需要加强安保……你去过<NAVI>[训练室]<INFO>dicastes01,255,172,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>吗？训练卫兵好像永远都不会睡觉！

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
This is one of the most important reasons why they live here.
If you go to the <NAVI>[factory]<INFO>dicastes01,97,256,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, you can see the recently refined Bradium.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
这是他们选择住在这里的重要原因之一。去<NAVI>[工厂]<INFO>dicastes01,97,256,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>的话，就能看到最近精炼出的魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
Although I arrived here as the first adventurer, the owner of the pub was the first person here.
<NAVI>[Bumen Florine's pub]<INFO>dicastes01,136,106,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> is located underground in the lower residential area.
He might have some valuable information for you.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
虽然我是第一个来到这里的冒险者，但酒馆老板才是最早来到这里的人。<NAVI>[布门·弗洛琳的酒馆]<INFO>dicastes01,136,106,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>位于下层居住区的地下。他也许有重要情报告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Ichack]
The <NAVI>[cats]<INFO>dicastes01,199,39,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> don't seem to have a good relationship with the Sapha like we do.
Perhaps it's because trading is involved.
Poor cats. They must be shivering from the cold out there.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者伊查克]
<NAVI>[猫咪]<INFO>dicastes01,199,39,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>似乎不像我们一样，和萨法族相处得那么融洽。也许是因为贸易关系吧。可怜的猫咪，它们在外面一定冻得瑟瑟发抖。

You can find their caravan just outside the gates.
scripts.translation:
